title: Dynabeads Wastewater Virus Enrichment & Total Nucleic Acid Extraction
author: Victor Mabasa
materials: Select the appropriate program on the instrument (Wastewater_10mL_Virus_Isolation)
Follow the manufacturer's protocol available here: https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0025695_MM_Wastewater_Ultra_NA_Isol_Kit_10mL_UG.pdf
Follow the manufacturer's protocol available here: https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0025695_MM_Wastewater_Ultra_NA_Isol_Kit_10mL_UG.pdf

steps.title: Prepare enrichment plates
steps.instruction: Label five 24‑deep‑well plates as follows and add the indicated reagents to each well: Plate 1 (Sample plate 1) – 5 000 µL clarified supernatant; Plate 2 (Dynabeads) – 100 µL Dynabeads; Plate 3 (Sample plate 2) – 5 000 µL clarified supernatant; Plate 4 (Lysis buffer) – 500 µL lysis buffer; Plate 5 (Tip comb) – tip comb (no liquid).

steps.title: Start enrichment run
steps.instruction: Start the instrument run, then load the prepared Sample plates, Dynabeads plate, Lysis buffer plate, and Tip‑comb plate into the positions indicated by the instrument when prompted.

steps.title: Prepare extraction plates
steps.instruction: While the enrichment run is processing (≈20 min), set up and label four additional 24‑deep‑well plates outside the instrument:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 – Wash Buffer 1: add 1 000 µL Wash Buffer 1 per well.
Plate 2 – Wash Buffer 2: add 1 000 µL 80 % ethanol per well.
Plate 3 – Elution: add 100 µL Elution Solution per well.
Plate 4 – Tip comb: place a tip comb (no liquid).

steps.title: Retrieve lysis plate
steps.instruction: When the enrichment process is complete (approximately 20 minutes after starting the run), remove the Lysis plate from the instrument, store it safely for the next extraction step, and discard all other plates from the instrument.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL Proteinase K to each enriched sample well in the Lysis plate.

steps.title: Add Binding beads
steps.instruction: Invert the Binding Bead Mix tube several times to fully resuspend the beads, then dispense 520 µL of the bead suspension into each well of the Lysis plate.

steps.title: Run nucleic‑acid extraction
steps.instruction: Load the Lysis plate together with the prepared Wash 1, Wash 2, Elution plates and a new tip comb into the instrument, start the run, and select the program “Wastewater_10mL_Virus_Extraction”.

steps.title: Collect and store eluate
steps.instruction: Immediately after the run finishes, remove the Elution plate, cover it, and either keep the eluate in the plate or transfer it to a new tube/plate. Store the isolated nucleic acid at –20 °C for up to 6 months or at –80 °C for longer storage.
